messages.subject: Siemens Thailand | Industrial transformation, stakeholder strategy and ASEAN execution
messages.body:
Dear Siemens Thailand Leadership Team,

I am writing because Siemens sits at the intersection of industrial competitiveness, electrification, digital infrastructure and decarbonization, precisely where my operating experience has become most relevant.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance, compliance and executive stakeholder strategy. I lead engagement across mining, environment, energy, labour, aviation, standards, taxation, trade and investment interfaces, and translate external obligations into clear internal ownership and delivery.

My value to Siemens would be strongest where industrial technology meets institutions and execution. I bring experience supporting a remote mine's transition toward approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, alongside carbon-data governance work built from physical operating records. I also bring the stakeholder discipline required to move complex initiatives across regulators, technical teams, communities and senior leadership.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, ASEAN or wider APAC mandates spanning external affairs, strategic partnerships, sustainability, country strategy or industrial stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Siemens-focused executive CV outlining where I see the strongest fit.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
